name: next-task
title: Next Task
description: Ask Claude what to work on next, based on your calendar, Jira board, Slack and Gmail.
author: jakeobsen

commands.name: next-task
commands.title: Next Task
commands.description: Runs Claude Code headless to pick the single most useful thing to work on next, with alternatives.

preferences.name: model
preferences.title: Model
preferences.description: Opus picked better tasks in side-by-side runs; Sonnet is faster and cheaper but cut corners.

preferences.name: effort
preferences.title: Effort
preferences.description: Higher effort reads more carefully but takes longer and costs more.

preferences.name: reuseMinutes
preferences.title: Reuse Answer For (Minutes)
preferences.description: Opening the command within this many minutes of the last answer shows it instead of asking again. ⌘R always asks again.

preferences.name: resolvedEmojis
preferences.title: Resolved Reactions
preferences.description: Slack reactions (comma-separated, colons optional) that mark a request as done. Inserted wherever the workflow says {{resolvedReactions}}.

preferences.name: claudePath
preferences.title: Claude CLI Path
preferences.description: Absolute path to the claude binary. Raycast does not see your shell PATH, so a bare `claude` will not resolve.
